title: Repair before replace
summary: Extending the life of phones, fans, mixers, and furniture often avoids both cost and manufacturing impact. Compare repair quotes you actually receive with replacement prices you actually see.
content:
Use local repair shops, authorised service centres, or community repair events if they exist where you live. EcoPath.AI will not name unverified Hyderabad shops or claim a subsidy that has not been checked.

When replacement may be reasonable: safety risk (electrical, gas), or a documented much higher BEE star rating where you have compared nameplates and your tariff. Even then, enter the quotes — do not use placeholder rupee amounts as if they were invoices.
implementation_steps: Get a written or messaged repair quote in ₹
Use Compare (repair vs replace) with those two numbers
limitations: Spare parts and labour vary by city and brand
source_title: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (for labelled replacements only)
source_publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Government of India
